subject: Auli Lifestyle — WhatsApp replies before the cart goes cold
body:
Hi Aishwarya,

I was looking at Auli Lifestyle (Mumbai). What stood out is that found 12 instances of faq_volume references.

I'm Vansh, founder of Inowix. We built COMAI to handle WhatsApp and Instagram commerce chat for Indian skincare brands — product questions, order updates, and follow-ups in seconds, including after hours.

For a team like yours, that usually means more conversions from the same ad spend without adding another support shift.

Would a short 15-minute walkthrough of how COMAI could sit on Auli Lifestyle's WhatsApp be useful?
